title: 🔆🔅QESHM, Iran — October 12, 2026 — Fire at a traditional wooden boat-building yard in Pey Posht, Qeshm, contained; flames did not reach two large boats.
text:
🔆🔅QESHM, Iran — October 12, 2026 — Fire at a traditional wooden boat-building yard in Pey Posht, Qeshm, contained; flames did not reach two large boats."

"The head of the Qeshm Fire Department said a fire at one of the traditional wooden boat-building workshops in Pey Posht, where boats known locally as *lanjes* are built, was contained with the presence of firefighting forces and the participation of emergency teams from industrial companies and various parts of the island."

"Forces at the scene moved two large traditional wooden boats away from the vicinity of the burning vessel and, by separating the boats and carrying out cooling operations, prevented the fire from spreading."

"In the incident, one traditional wooden boat burned completely, but the cooperation of operational forces and timely action to secure nearby vessels prevented further damage.
